backend.telemetry_source: EVCS Public API (REST, direct VinFast CDN)

database_schema.summary: Cloud Firestore stores user favorites under /users/{userId}/userdata/favorites as a map of station IDs to timestamps.
database_schema.relationships_explained: Each user owns exactly one favorites document at /users/{userId}/userdata/favorites.

features: Native Station Detail Bottom Sheet with VinFast S3 Photo Carousel, Lightbox Zoom, and Recomposition-isolated RotatingRefreshIcon
Local-First Firestore Favorites Sync with Anonymous & 1-Tap Google Sign-In and redundant write suppression
Tab UI & LazyColumn Scroll State Preservation across AppTab navigation
Direct CDN Media URL Decoding (Bypassing Cloudflare HTTP 403)

patterns: VinFast CDN media double base64 URL decoding to bypass evcs.vn 403
Firestore Map structure favorites.[stationId] for atomic add/delete
Isolated Composable for continuous rotation animations (RotatingRefreshIcon) to prevent parent sheet recomposition storm
SaveableStateProvider(currentTab) for seamless bottom navigation without scroll reset
allowRgb565 in Coil ImageRequest to halve Bitmap RAM consumption for photo carousels
gotchas: evcs.vn /media endpoint blocks requests with Cloudflare 403; decode double base64 to cpo-prod-s3.vinfastauto.com direct URL instead
FieldValue.arrayRemove requires exact byte match; use Map updates instead
Reading animation float state in a root composable body triggers 60-120fps recomposition storm of the entire screen hierarchy; always isolate in dedicated Composable or graphicsLayer block
Building AGP projects on Ubuntu without openjdk-21-jdk-headless fails on JdkImageTransform due to missing jlink; use standalone Temurin JDK 17 configured in gradle.properties
